Students from the discipline of mathematics in colleges P and R taken together is what percentage of the total number of students in colleges P and R taken together? [Give your answer correct to one decimal place]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Discipline of mathematics in colleges P and R taken together = (30/100 × 8000) + (40/100 × 15000)

⇒ 2400 + 6000

⇒ 8400 students

Total number of students in colleges P and R taken together = 8000 + 15000

⇒ 23000 students

Percentage of students of mathematics in colleges P and R taken together to the total number of students in colleges P and R taken together = 8400/23000 × 100

⇒ 8400/230 = 36.5%

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
